name: BD
notes: PIWA Intercontinental Champion entering March Madness (8 March 1997); lost the title there to "Dancin'" Stevie Richards in a barb-wire cage match.
caption: Lost the PIWA Intercontinental title in a barb-wire cage match.

name: Stevie Richards

identity.note: A per-promotion portrayal of the real wrestler Stevie Richards -- never merged with the pre-existing stevie-richards-ewa-email or stevie-richards-pwe-inc portrayal rows, which are independent creative acts about the same real performer.

notes: Won the PIWA Intercontinental Championship from BD in a barb-wire cage match on March Madness (8 March 1997).
caption: Won the PIWA Intercontinental Championship in a barb-wire cage match.

name: Tommy Angel
notes: PIWA United States Champion entering March Madness (8 March 1997); lost the title there to Devil's Messenger.
caption: Lost the PIWA United States Championship on March Madness.

name: Devil's Messenger
notes: Billed as a former Television Champion; won the PIWA United States Championship from Tommy Angel on March Madness (8 March 1997).
caption: Won the PIWA United States Championship on March Madness.

name: Syxx

identity.note: A per-promotion portrayal of the real wrestler Syxx/Sean Waltman -- never merged with the pre-existing syxx-agw or syxx-newf portrayal rows.

notes: Billed with the nWo; lost to Menace II Society by count-out (nWo interference at ringside) in the opening match of March Madness, 8 March 1997.
caption: Lost the opening match of a PIWA PPV by count-out despite nWo backup at ringside.

name: Menace II Society
notes: Won the opening match of March Madness over Syxx by count-out, 8 March 1997, after the nWo's ringside interference backfired.
caption: Won a PIWA PPV opener by count-out after turning the tables on the nWo.

name: Johnny Star
notes: A four-time PIWA champion and leader of the in-fiction Star Corporation stable; served as guest commentator and gave an interview on injury/comeback plans during March Madness (8 March 1997), then led his stable into the closing multi-stable brawl.
caption: A four-time PIWA champion who led his own stable into a multi-stable brawl while recovering from injury.
